title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
description:
E4
Nicknamed The Chameleon, Frédéric Bourdin is a former French serial imposter who claims to have faked at least five hundred false identities, including a young Texas boy who went missing in the mid-90s.

title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
description:
E5
Shaun Greenhalgh is a British artist and art forger; between 1989 and 2006, he produced a number of forgeries including Roman and Chinese art objects, and medieval Christian relics, that fooled some of the world's most respected art institutions.

title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
description:
E6
Dubbed the "Mini Madoff," Kiener is one of Germany's greatest con artists, tricking thousands of private investors and banks, including Barclays and J.P. Morgan, to the tune of more than $300 million.

title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
description:
E2

title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
description:
E1

title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
description:

title: Rescued Chimpanzees of the Congo With Jane Goodall
description:
E1
The sanctuary embarks on an ambitious project to release suitable chimpanzees back to the wild.

title: Rescued Chimpanzees of the Congo With Jane Goodall
description:
E2
Testing the chimpanzees' survival skills; searching for a release site; infant George learns how to crack open nuts; Dr. Cat Hobaiter reveals secrets to chimpanzee gestures; the sniffer dog team's new recruit succeeds on his first mission.

title: Rescued Chimpanzees of the Congo With Jane Goodall
description:
E3
Back at the sanctuary, the baby group goes on their daily forest school trip, to learn how to live in the wild.

title: Rescued Chimpanzees of the Congo With Jane Goodall
description:
E4
Dr. Rebeca Atencia releases the first two chimps to their new semi-wild existence on the sanctuary's new islands, then sets out to rescue an illegally kept pet mandrill, but encounters resistance from angry villagers.

title: Rescued Chimpanzees of the Congo With Jane Goodall
description:
E5
The release group's survival tests continue, and we meet the other animals cared for at Tchimpounga.

title: Rescued Chimpanzees of the Congo With Jane Goodall
description:
E6
Rebeca returns from a rescue mission in Angola with eight chimpanzees; scientists study the survival skills of the group, which they release into the wild; researchers also develop a mandrill reintroduction program.
